agenda_text:
TRANSACTIONS AND USE TAX CITIZENS'
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Rolando Cruz, Chair  Uduak-Joe Ntuk, Member
Jan Hower, Vice Chair  David Ochoa, Member
Robert Emigh, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54651  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Transactions and Use Tax
  Citizens’ Advisory Committee meeting of Thursday, February 5, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54653  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Infrastructure and Assessments
  from the Public Works Department.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54654  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Financial
  Management Department regarding Measure A Bonds.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54655  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Financial Management
  Department regarding Measure A Performance in FY 25 and to confirm that the
  City Manager’s proposed revision to the FY 26 Measure A spending plan conforms
  with the intent of Resolution Nos. RES-16-0018 and RES-19-0127 prioritizing
  spending and with the language contained in the ballot measure expressed in
  Resolution Nos. RES-16-0017 and RES-19-0173.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54656  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Financial
  Management Department regarding the timeline of the Budget Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54657  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committee;

  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Transactions and Use Tax Citizens' Advisory Committee on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
